id: # The domestic facilities of cities-and-facilities.md. One row for each facility that the develop command builds.
# cost, durability: documented (manual p.11, p.29; guide book p.9, p.23).
# min_days: the shortest period. documented for the 10 base facilities (guide book p.23); assumed for the PK facilities (the manual gives no period).

# effect: gold (income each month), grain (income each season), mint, granary, conscription, weapons, horses, siege, ships, technique, action_points, personnel, plot, diplomacy, military, drill, grain_by_soldiers.
# value: gold each month or grain each season of one level-1 facility. All values are assumed (Q-021); the ratios of the PK markets are documented (manual p.29).
# limit: none, city (one in each city), big_city (one, big city only), port_city (one, city with a port), territory (one in the whole territory).
# adjacency_bonus: yes if an adjacent mint or granary gives 1.5 times the value (documented, cities-and-facilities.md).
